name: Sagicor Financial Company Ltd.
summary: Sagicor Financial Company Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides various financial services to individuals and corporations in Canada, the United States, Jamaica, and the rest of the Caribbean. It operates through Sagicor Canada, Sagicor Life USA, Sagicor Jamaica, Sagicor Life, and Head Office and Other segments. The company offers life, health, general, property, casualty, accident, and sickness insurance; annuities and pension administration; investment, asset, and pension fund management; insurance brokerage; captive insurance management; investment, retail, and commercial banking; and microfinance.
